items.title: 리브리반트 10월 급여 등재… 렉라자 병용은 과제로
items.snippet: [히트뉴스=이현주 기자] EGFR 엑손20 삽입 변이 비소세포폐암 환자의 2차 이상 치료에 쓰이는 한국얀센의 '리브리반트주(성분명 아미반타맙)'가 위험분담제를 조건으로 건강보험 급여권에 진입한다. 2022년 2월 품목허가를 획득한 이후 약 4년 반만이다. 다만, 렉라자 병용 1차 치료 등을 포함한 다른 허가 적응증은 급여 대상에서 제외돼 환자가 약값 전액을 부담해야 한다.28일 관련 업계에 따르면 리브리반트주 350mg의 상한금액은 132만2570원으로 정해졌다. 환급형과 총액제한형, 실사용자료 수집 사후관리형 위험분담제가 적용된다

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Testing the Combination of Cediranib and Olaparib in Comparison to Each Drug Alone or Other Chemotherapy in Recurrent Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer (Phase 2/Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT02502266 | Sponsor: National Cancer Institute (NCI) | Condition: Fallopian Tube Clear Cell Adenocarcinoma, Fallopian Tube Endometrioid Adenocarcinoma, Fallopian Tube Serous Adenocarcinoma | Phase: Phase 2/Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. This randomized phase II/III trial studies how well cediranib maleate and olaparib work when given together or separately, and compares them to standard chemotherapy in treating patients with ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer that has returned (recurrent) after receiving chemotherapy with drugs that contain platinum (platinum-resistant) or continued to grow while being treated

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Phase 3 Study of Pelabresib (DAK539) and Ruxolitinib in Myelofibrosis (MF) (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT07357727 | Sponsor: Novartis Pharmaceuticals | Condition: Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF), Post-polycythemia Vera Myelofibrosis (PPV-MF), Post-essential Thrombocythemia Myelofibrosis (PET-MF) | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The purpose of this trial is to evaluate whether treatment with pelabresib in combination with ruxolitinib leads to improved clinical outcomes compared to ruxolitinib alone in patients with primary myelofibrosis (PMF), post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis (PPV-MF), or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis (PET-MF) who have not previously received Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor therapy.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Pembrolizumab Plus Epacadostat, Pembrolizumab Monotherapy, and the EXTREME Regimen in Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma (KEYNOTE-669/ECHO-304) (Phase 3, COMPLETED)
